content.title: About
content.content: Cereal O's, NFS is a ready‑to‑eat breakfast made from whole grain wheat, corn and oats, fortified with vitamins and minerals. The flakes have a light crunchy texture and a mildly sweet taste, perfect for a quick breakfast with milk or yogurt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product was launched in 2023 as part of the "New Functional Snacks" (NFS) line.
The flakes contain whole grains, not just extracts, preserving more dietary fiber.
Vitamin D is added, a nutrient often missing in typical breakfasts.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.
The iconic "O's" shape was inspired by a ring symbolizing an endless energy cycle.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Whole grains provide dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion and satiety.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 aid energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron is essential for oxygen transport in the blood and helps prevent fatigue.

items.title: Fortified with vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D enhances calcium absorption and supports bone health.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: Sugar is limited to 5 g per 100 g, making it suitable for moderate consumption.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The product contains wheat, so it is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although low, individuals monitoring glycemic intake should account for the sugar present.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: A single serving (30 g) provides about 120 kcal; adding milk or yogurt increases total calories.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour milk, kefir, or a plant‑based drink over the flakes and wait 2–3 minutes. They can also be blended into smoothies, mixed with yogurt, used in baking, or as a crunchy topping for fruit salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the bag tightly to maintain crispness.
